bio: A cool and casual spot, there's a welcoming vibe to this neighbourhood operation that’s very much in the bistro mould. The cooking mixes a Polish base with influences from over the world – such as the Korean-style chilli sauce that smothers the pierogi – while the generous portions are indicative of the restaurant’s spirit. The interesting and ever-evolving wine list spotlights natural options, with plenty of orange and skin-contact varieties....
